svg.title: Three outputs without and with the skill: no ‑ው on “the office” for a website, ‑ን on the patients as the object, and a placeholder instead of an invented translation of the Constitution.

g.text: On a public website the reader doesn’t know which office, so no -ው.
“The doctor told the patients to drink more water.”
The patients are the object, so they take -ን. Without it, they read as a second subject.

text.tspan: ፊት እኩል ናቸው፤ ያለ ምንም ልዩነትም በሕግ

g.text: Without the skill, the model writes its own version of the law. With it, it leaves a place for the published text.
